Name: Karkor
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed sites include Al Qarqar and Wadi Sirhan
Description: The place in the desert east of Jordan where Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian, rested with their remaining fifteen thousand men before Gideon fell on them and took them.
BiblicalSignificance: Karkor is where Gideon's long pursuit ended: the Midianite kings thought the desert had hidden them, and it had not.
